stress_convention: World physical QIPC/Shell Cauchy corotated by each link's mass-weighted best fit; native authored-frame linear stress. Shared undeformed tangent projector; finite-strain model differences remain separate.

tangent_field.rule: End-of-interval time rectangles on the common observation grid. Every finite observation contributes, including near-zero-load intervals; no per-time relative-error mask or phase cut is applied. This is one field norm over time, not an additive error budget across modeling layers.
